column1: # The words a fronted wh-hole is said as when its role changes the wording:
# the Guide stores "how long have you been waiting?" as `for=?how`, the
# duration being the `for` phrase, so the wh is said "how long", not "how".
# preposition  the `Via` preposition of the slot the hole fills (`for`)
# words        what is said in place of the bare wh-word
# Linguistic source: Murphy Unit 14 ("How long have you been ...?").
